This transition came about following a significant event in his life: the unexpected passing of his mother, who was the sole supporter of his filmmaking aspirations. It was a significant blow when my mother, who was the only one in my family to support my passion for filmmaking, passed away. At that time, I was left to my own devices, with no one to guide me or provide me with the means to pursue my dreams. I was forced to find my own way, and it was a difficult and arduous journey. But I persevered, and eventually I found success as a filmmaker. I am grateful to my mother for instilling in me a love of art and a desire to create, and I will always remember her and the sacrifices she made for me.
